Recomputing under the documented definition reproduces the published values exactly — semicore shift -45.0 meV, semicore-aligned +52.1 meV. Fixed at 4aed10a97d4858ef7b18dea940e6bf66294e2849: the derivation now declares one convention in source (direction = defective minus aligned pristine; VBM = each cell's own VBM; semicore = mean of lowest 32 bands), asserts +75.8 / +52.1 / -45.0 against the raws, and asserts that both authority documents quote those exact values. The documents' +75.9 was a 0.1 meV rounding artifact (1.6319 vs exact 1.6318 eV above VBM), normalised to +75.8 with the artifact recorded in place. Regression [39] implements your C-Q3-NUM-001.
